programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.title: I Remember You
programme.desc: A young man and woman move to a small, abandoned town in Iceland and begin renovations on an old house. Little by little they learn about the town's dark history.

programme.title: Night's End
programme.desc: After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.

programme.title: Pyewacket
programme.desc: A frustrated, angst-ridden teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to evoke a witch to kill her mother.

programme.title: Relic
programme.desc: A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

programme.title: The Pact
programme.desc: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

programme.title: The Pact II
programme.desc: A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.

programme.title: The Dead Room
programme.desc: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

programme.title: American Fable
programme.desc: With her family's livelihood imperiled by the farm crisis during the 1980s, 11-year-old Gitty loses herself in a world of fantasy and make believe. But she stumbles into her own fairy tale when she makes a startling discovery: a well-dressed mystery man being held captive in her family's silo. It's the beginning of a labyrinthine journey that will turn Gitty's world upside down and force her to question her loyalty to her own family.

programme.title: Sanitarium
programme.desc: Three patients in an insane asylum experience hallucinations, altered realities and imaginary voices.

programme.title: Night of the Hunted
programme.desc: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

programme.title: Cold Weather
programme.desc: Armed with a few clues and an in-depth knowledge of Sherlock Holmes lore, an ice-factory worker (Cris Lankenau) leads his sister and a co-worker on a search for his missing former lover.

programme.title: The Last Thing Mary Saw
programme.desc: In the spring of 1840, a family gathers in their old, isolated farm house to mourn the loss of their matriarch. As the mourning proceeds, the circumstances of the matriarch's death come into question.

programme.title: Swallow
programme.desc: A young housewife in a seemingly perfect marriage develops pica, the irresistible urge to ingest inedible objects and material.

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: An elderly couple turn the tables on a group of young thieves who broke into their house while they were away.

programme.title: The Dry
programme.desc: A federal agent investigates the decades-old death of a teenage girl in his drought-stricken hometown.

programme.title: Antiviral
programme.desc: Syd sells illegal samples of live viruses from sick celebrities to piracy groups, smuggling them in his own body. He becomes infected with the disease that kills Hannah Geist. He must unravel the mystery of her death before he suffers the same fate.

programme.title: American Star
programme.desc: An assassin on his last assignment travels to Fuerteventura to kill a man he's never met.

programme.title: Impetigore
programme.desc: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she is unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

programme.title: The Whole Gritty City
programme.desc: Directors of three New Orleans marching bands prepare students to perform in the Mardi Gras parades. What emerges is a dramatic, music-filled story of children struggling to reach adulthood in one of America's most impoverished and violent cities.

programme.title: The Godfathers of Hardcore
programme.desc: An intimate look at the lives and careers of two of the most respected individuals in the history of hardcore punk music: Roger Miret and Vinnie Stigma of the iconic punk hardcore band Agnostic Front.

programme.title: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Peter Short, the charismatic CEO of a major Australian company, learns that he has only months to live after he is diagnosed with terminal oesophageal cancer. Not wanting to face a painful death, Peter sets out to have voluntary euthanasia legalised.

programme.title: Qwerty
programme.desc: In this heartwarming romantic comedy, Zoe's life is turned upside down when she falls for outcast Marty. Together, they battle a dysfunctional family and self-doubt as Zoe trains for the National Scrabble Championship.

programme.title: Riverfront Romance
programme.desc: After saving up for years, writer Cara Durant finally buys her dream house on the riverbank of her hometown, only to discover a hydro dam being built right in front of it, spearheaded by the handsome and nomadic Riley Evans.

programme.title: Missing Pieces
programme.desc: A heartbroken man kidnaps two strangers in hopes they will fall in love.

programme.title: The Prayer
programme.desc: It is a drama and faith-based film about two ambitious college students. Mark and Tom became good friends despite a rocky beginning at gunpoint that almost cost Mark his life.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Dog Patrol: Operation Santa Paws
programme.desc: When little Samuel's loyal dog, Athena, uncovers clues tied to a mob boss's sinister plot, the duo must band together with friends and Sheriff Jacobs to solve riddles, outsmart the bad guys, and save Christmas.

programme.title: Insectula!
programme.desc: A giant mosquito monster wreaks havoc on the world. After it kills a loved one, government agent Del pursues his own personal vendetta against the creature, while mad scientist Dr. Kempler decides to help it cleanse the world of its human inhabitants.

programme.title: The Penitent Man
programme.desc: When a mysterious client reveals he is from the future, a psychologist heeds the man's warning and sets out to change the course of his life.

programme.title: Favorite Son
programme.desc: When David returns to his childhood hometown, he is still haunted by old secrets. David is the last one the town elders want near the young, troubled Ross, but David might be the only one who can save Ross from an evil haunting the town.

programme.title: Is It Just Me?
programme.desc: A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: The Suppressor
programme.desc: A man seeks brutal revenge against the dangerous criminals who killed his wife.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The President's Staff
programme.desc: The President, his intern, and two technicians discover that the Oval Office has been wired with bombs that prevent them from leaving. With 24 hours until detonation, they must decipher the secret of the devices before the White House is blown sky-high.

programme.title: Obscura
programme.desc: A reclusive young photographer, Andrew Kaleen (Andrew John), incidentally becomes wrapped up in a string of murders delivered through clues in the form of a 35mm film.

programme.title: Patient Seven
programme.desc: Dr. Marcus, a renowned psychiatrist, has selected six severely mentally ill and dangerous patients from the Spring Valley Mental Hospital to interview as part of his research for his new book.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Zero Days
programme.desc: The malware worm Stuxnet, famously used against Iranian centrifuges, has been claimed by many to have originated as a joint effort between America and Israel.

programme.title: Casino Jack and the United States of Money
programme.desc: This documentary tracks the high life and eventual downfall of wealthy lobbyist and businessman Jack Abramoff, who was convicted of conspiracy and fraud, among other charges, in a corruption scandal during the George W. Bush administration. The film details Abramoff's decadent and lavish lifestyle and reveals the shady dealings that led to his getting arrested, which ultimately resulted in a prison sentence for him and tarnished reputations for others.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

programme.title: The Napa Boys
programme.desc: A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.

programme.title: Tapawingo
programme.desc: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

programme.title: Support the Girls
programme.desc: Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Permanent
programme.desc: Aurelie, 13, dreams about getting a perm so that she can finally fit in at her small-town Virginia school. Things soon go incredibly wrong when her clueless parents bring her to a beauty school to save a few bucks.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: En route to Canada with stolen casino loot, a thief (Olivia Wilde) separates from her brother (Eric Bana) and falls in with a boxer (Charlie Hunnam) who's on his way home for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Tyrel
programme.desc: Tyler spirals out of control when he realizes he's the only black person attending a weekend birthday party in a secluded cabin.

programme.title: Frances Ferguson
programme.desc: A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Building the ultimate Italian cheeseboard; skilled sausage and peppers; St. Joseph's zeppole, fried dough filled with vanilla cream topped with Amarena cherries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes Season 1
programme.desc: In this moving special, acclaimed chef and food ambassador Lidia Bastianich pays homage to the men and women of our military and the truly life-saving sacrifices they make daily for our freedom. Lidia meets seven veterans, who share their incredibly inspiring stories.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mushroom ragu; Moka coffee; Kaiserschmarrn, a light and fluffy eggy pancake topped with jam.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter panzanella; a mix of warm roasted vegetables tossed with bread and kale; crespelle bar; farina gnocchi.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Bounty of Parma

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: How do you make any dish even more delicious? Just add cheese! Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Holidays and special occasions call for showstopping main courses that take a little extra time. Vegetarians, this one's for you - Sara's elegant Butternut Squash and Date Crostata. programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Cooking fish can be tricky but not with these easy, foolproof fish recipes. First, Sara is joined by food journalist and influencer Anna Gass to make Pesce all'Acqua Pazza. programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - My Heart, My Home

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Ciudad Juárez, Pati joins in with a group of Pachuco dancers, who are passionately preserving this distinctive Prohibition-era culture's traditions. Together they head to the iconic Kentucky Bar, rumored to be the birthplace of the margarita. Later, she savors an icon of Juárez's food scene, the burrito, at Burritos El Compa where the Olivares are keeping their family legacy alive.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Cured and Smoked: In humankind's long march to food security, two ancient preserving techniques have stood out over the millennia: curing and smoking. The first involves preserving foods with salt, soy sauce, or sodium nitrite, and the second technique involves blasting foods with flavorful clouds of wood smoke. Today, we're pushing the envelope on traditional curing and smoking.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Cured and Smoked

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Maryland Crab Feast

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Raichlen's Rules: Desserts: Take your desserts to a new level of flavor with Grilled Pound Cake with Berry Salsa and Smoked Whipped Cream, Salt Slab-Grilled Pears with Amaretti And Smoked Whipped Cream, Dessert Quesadillas, Smoked Ice Cream with Rum Raisin Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules Desserts

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Let Texans brag about brisket and Carolinians praise pulled pork shoulder. For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue is ribs. In the American Midwest, ribs mean baby backs or other pork ribs, while in Korea, the bone of choice is the beef short rib. In the eastern Mediterranean, lamb ribs reign supreme. In this show we give you three of the best ribs ever.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Best Ribs Ever

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire. In this show we embark on some meaty globe hopping, exploring over-the-top steaks from France, Cambodia, and the American Southwest. Hot fire. Sizzling meat. It's a carnivore's dream come true.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Planet Steak

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The 'green' city of Germany has an incredible gothic cathedral with a food market at its feet. Every morning, six days a week, farmers from the Black Forest bring their trout and herb pestoes, wild berries, and smoked ham to the city. Be it a vegan wurst or a tasty cheesecake, here the surprises never finish!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Freiburg

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: An enchanting city, Barcelona is brimming with inspirations left by the greatest of artists. But this charming city has another jewel in its crown - La Boqueria food market. Take a journey through the senses with our lively characters and uncover their gastronomic secrets.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Barcelona

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits Laconia, where the famous Kalamata olive is cultivated, to follow the famous olive from harvest to table. After a chilly day of collecting, scoring, and processing the ripened fruits, Diane heads to the kitchen to whip up an olive feast. Find out how olives can transform any meal into a masterpiece.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The World's Most Famous Olive

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane travels to her family's native island of Ikaria, where locals are 10 times more likely to live to one hundred than Americans. Diane's young 85-year-old neighbors share a lesson in making wild herb teas; a beekeeper reveals the honey that is one of the secrets to Ikarians' renowned longevity. Enjoy the deliciously simple and wonderfully healthy cuisine of Ikaria.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors of Longevity - Ikaria

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the ancient grains that Greek cooks still love to use. Learn how to incorporate timeless ancient grains into every meal of the day.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Ancient Grains for Modern Cooks

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Emerald green Greek extra virgin olive oil is the star of this show. Diane takes us on a journey to the stunningly preserved town of Monemvasia. Explore the diversity and beauty of one of Greece's most delectable exports.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Olive Oil Everything

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the meze tradition of small plates of vibrant food meant to be shared. She uncovers the vast variety and robust flavors of the meze table and invites a wine expert into the kitchen for advice on what to pair when the meal includes spice, yogurt, cheese, crunch, comfort, seafood, meat and more, all in one sitting. Discover the fun and festive meze tradition.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Meze Society

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Go on a picnic at a vineyard in Naoussa were one grape dominates the table: the local Xinomavro, one of Greece's noblest reds. On the wine trail, Diane discovers bread, cookies and chocolate truffles all spiked with this hard-to-pronounce but easy-to-love Greek varietal. Learn how to incorporate incomparable Greek wine into any menu, both as a drink and an ingredient.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Bite of Greek Red Wine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane celebrates the intensely flavored food and unique wines of one of Greece's most breathtaking islands, Santorini. Diane hops in a boat to pick capers on this volcanic island. She visits a renowned vineyard which still practices the island tradition of growing grapes in basket-shaped vines. Enjoy the tastes of Santorini with ingredients from field to sea.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors Of A Volcano

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques suggests that mastering simple skills and techniques will make your life easier and when you're comfortable in the kitchen, you'll be more creative and avoid the trap of a quick fix with a frozen meal...or worse! He teaches you how to sharpen knives, cut and prepare vegetables and eggs and finally make a delicious gratin.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Kitchen Techniques

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don't have to spend a fortune if you chose what's in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you're in a hurry, it's okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Fruit Deserts

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.sub-title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.
